title: Design leftovers and the reply note on agent reconnect
body:
Small leftovers from the final design check of the Remote Sessions UI (HEAD 1077dc1 and later) plus one reconnect gap. All are local changes; no new features.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md. Feature doc: docs/remote-sessions.md.
Blocked by: Final design pass on the Remote Sessions UI
Do:
N1. Remotes pane edit form (src/remotes_pane.rs, RemotesView::key in Mode::Edit): a saved Project directory can only be cleared with the mouse, and blanking the field saves "home directory", not "ask again". Give a key that calls clear_dir on the focused Field::Dir row (Ctrl+Backspace, or Delete on an empty field), and show it in the hint while a directory field is focused. The hint must still fit one line at PANE_MIN_W (hint_fits test).
N2. launcher::state_line for Reach::Unknown is about 60 characters, wider than the note can ever be, and the tooltip was shortened to "reachability unknown", so the reason is unreadable for every ProxyJump Remote. Shorten the copy so it fits (for example "behind a proxy hop, cannot check") and keep the reason in the segment tooltip. The launcher's offline wording duplicates remotes_pane::OFFLINE_WHY in different words; use one source.
N3. render_form Project path label truncates the END of the path, so sibling Projects under one long parent look identical. Elide the front instead and keep the full path on hover; add a small gap before each Project row so a Directory row cannot be read as belonging to the next Project. Check the empty-state line fits one line at PANE_MIN_W.
N4. hover_menu strip: scroll the selected segment into view with the fade width as margin so paint_fade does not cover it or its status mark.
N5. The disconnected dot: the icon tooltip still reads only "Remote: desk (target)". Append the disconnected state to the tooltip when the dot is shown. A filled dot means reachable in the launcher strip and disconnected on a tab; make the two visibly different shapes or say so in a comment if they already are.
N6. Toast copy for a split from a re-pointed Remote uses "this" for two things. Use: "desk now points to X; this Session is on Y. Opened the new terminal on this PC."
N7. The target comparison that decides "re-pointed" is case-sensitive; compare host names case-insensitively so retyping a target in another case does not send splits Local.
R1. Reconnect gap. After a reconnect the new reply note waits for the first chat delivery, so a resumed agent keeps using the old curl command from its conversation and gets 401 until someone posts to it (see docs/remote-sessions.md, "The token is per connection"). When the reconnect relaunches an agent (remote::relaunch reports an agent), arm the reply note at launch through the existing ReplyNote path, exactly as a first launch with a command does; a shell reconnect is unchanged. Update that gotcha in docs/remote-sessions.md.
Do NOT: add a keyboard path to the launcher strip; change when the disconnected dot shows for never-connected restored Sessions. Both are open decisions for the human.
Done when:
- unit tests cover N1 (key clears the row, hint fits), N2 (state line length fits for every Reach state), N7, and R1 (an agent reconnect arms the note at launch exactly once; a shell reconnect does not)
- the full test suite passes
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent
